name: Ahmad al-Wansharisi
contribution: A Berber Muslim theologian and jurist of the Maliki school around the time of the fall of Granada.
legacy: He was one of the leading authorities on the issues of Iberian Muslims living under Christian rule.

checks.lead: Ahmad ibn Yahya al-Wansharisi (Arabic: أحمد بن يحيى الونشريسي, full name: Abu ’l-ʿAbbās Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn ʿAlī al-Wansharīsī or simply known as al-Wansharisi, b. 1430 or 1431 in Ouarsenis, d. 1508 in Fez) was a Berber Muslim theologian and jurist of the Maliki school around the time of the fall of Granada. He was one of the leading authorities on the issues of Iberian Muslims living under Christian rule.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
